choices.label: Any authorized report reader
choices.effect: Permit any current same-tenant class-scoped accounting report reader to inspect each job and artifact. Download still requires separately specified current export authority and a guarded private delivery path.
choices.tradeoff: Broad team visibility; provider/key and financial job metadata available to readers who did not create the export.

choices.label: Creator only
choices.effect: Only the original creator with current read scope may inspect; current export authority required to download.
choices.tradeoff: Smallest initial access footprint; accounting handover and review need a new export or separately approved procedure.

choices.label: Creator plus explicit delegates
choices.effect: Creator or an explicitly named, revocable same-tenant delegate may inspect, subject to current read/class/module/location scope; current export authority plus fresh authentication required to issue a delivery grant.
choices.tradeoff: Supports controller/auditor handoff while restricting file exposure; needs a bounded delegation and delivery implementation after approval.

proposed_policy.business_rationale: Financial export contents and storage references can contain more history/detail than a report reader currently needs; controlled handoff supports continuity without automatic tenant-wide access.
proposed_policy.metadata_authority: creator OR explicit active same-tenant actor/job grant; creator status alone never overrides current permissions
proposed_policy.download_authority: metadata authority AND accounting.exports.create AND current underlying class read scope AND fresh authentication (300 seconds for issuing the delivery grant)
proposed_policy.delegation: Named actor, job/contentHash, inspect/download capability, grantor, reason, start, expiry and revocation evidence. No onward delegation or scope widening by default. Grantor and recipient must hold corresponding current authority.
proposed_policy.default_for_all_classes: C approved for all 14 listed classes; implementation/delivery remains unqualified
proposed_policy.existing_aggregate_queue_summary: Keep existing same-tenant accounting.reports.read summary boundary; do not silently include per-job locator metadata.
proposed_policy.expired_artifact_history: Eligible creator/delegate may read retained historical status with current read scope; omit provider/key and delivery grants. Expiry does not revoke independently authorized aggregate summary.

acceptance_cases.acceptance: Current authorized creator reads own same-tenant status and downloads the exact artifact once its class and export authority pass.
Same-tenant reader without creator status or an explicit grant receives no job metadata, provider/key, file bytes or existence distinction.
Same-tenant explicitly delegated reader with current underlying read scope sees granted status/metadata only; download denied without current export authority.
Same-tenant delegated exporter with all current scopes and fresh authentication downloads only the granted job/hash until expiry.
Other-tenant creator, reader, administrator or delegate cannot inspect or download; forged organization, job, key and manifest rejected.

Creator permission removal, session revocation/expiry, module deactivation and location/period restriction removal take effect on next status/download; historic creation grants no continuing authority.
Grant revoked/expired/wrong actor/wrong job/wrong content hash is denied; direct object key/old URL does not bypass current policy.
An administrator needs explicit current class/export authority; role name alone does not bypass scope. Delegation cannot exceed grantor or recipient authority.
Concurrent revocation or artifact replacement during storage latency is rechecked before bytes are released. Expired artifacts do not yield a fresh delivery grant.
Denied reads leave business/job/artifact/grant state unchanged; permitted security audit entries are classified separately.
Queue summary remains tenant-scoped under its separately approved existing reports.read boundary and contains no per-job artifact locator.
Existing callers and absent/unknown jobs retain a safe uniform denial; browser back/reload does not restore unauthorized metadata/download affordances.
